definition: each chain as the closed surface that holds its own volume (0.135 nm³ for each amino acid, 0.32 nm³ for each nucleotide) in a cloud where each residue is spread as a Gaussian 1.5 nm wide, on a grid 1.5 nm apart (coarser than the setting's 1 nm, to hold the budget); of a surface in pieces, its largest and every piece of at least 5% of its volume are kept, smaller ones dropped (listed under dropped)
